summary:
• Gemini 4 Neon — Google’s new large‑language model that acts as a software engineer and researcher, offering million‑token context and reduced hallucinations for complex multi‑step workflows.
• datasette‑arrows — a community plugin for the open‑source Datasette platform that streams Apache Arrow exports, enabling memory‑light, high‑throughput data transfers for large tables.
• Daybreak Red — an OpenAI reference architecture for a supervised security‑investigation assistant, providing turnkey LLM integration, audit‑ready logging, and real‑time risk scoring for SOC teams.
• PR‑scans demo — a walkthrough showing an LLM automatically reviewing pull requests within GitHub’s UI, surfacing security, style, and performance insights without extra permissions.
• Performance Factory — OpenAI’s internal Codex‑powered system that continuously detects latency regressions in ChatGPT, generates micro‑optimisations, and deploys patches via automated CI.
• Apple on‑device AI agent — a rumored Mac‑based assistant that can navigate apps, browse the web, and write or debug code while keeping all data private on the device.
